Mass shootings are incidents involving several victims of firearm-related violence.
The precise inclusion criteria are disputed, and there is no broadly accepted definition.[1][2] Only shootings that have Wikipedia articles of their own are included in this list.
Detailed lists of mass shootings can be found per year at their respective pages.
